evals.name: plan-b-reel-script
evals.prompt: Quero um roteiro de reel de ~25s para o Instagram do Wealth & Migration Summit sobre a ideia de ter um Plan B (residência, cidadania e patrimônio como uma decisão só). Vou postar dia 23/10.
evals.expected_output: script.md in the template: contiguous beat table (<=35s), hook 0-3s with on-screen text <=7 words + spoken line, keyword in first 3s, English copy, one speaker per beat, no testimonials, Advance Rate €499 until 30 Oct only if price used, 'Before publishing' with audio/link/tier. qa_reel.py script passes. Delivers the script and summarises assumptions; no video or image generation tool called.
assertions: script.md follows the template (all six ## sections + header lines incl. Presenter) and `qa_reel.py script` reports 0 errors
Beat 1 has on-screen text of 7 words or fewer AND a spoken line (hook works on mute)
No spoken line reports a personal result (no 'I/we moved/got/obtained...')
Any price quoted is the Advance Rate €499 with its 30 Oct end date stated
No video or image generation was started and the skill does not offer to produce video itself

evals.name: longevity-session-reel-facts
evals.prompt: faz um roteiro de reel de 20 segundos divulgando a sessão 'Longevity Is the New Luxury' do dia 2 do summit. Me mostra o script e a legenda do post.
evals.expected_output: Session title verbatim from programme.json ('Longevity Is the New Luxury'), time only 11:30 and Day Two (6 Nov) if stated, any person named must be on the speaker roster (Dr. Joana Costa is agenda-only: qa_reel.py flags her), 'Programme subject to change' in caption, no invented facts.
assertions: Session title appears verbatim as 'Longevity Is the New Luxury' and any time used is only 11:30
No agenda-only name (Cintia Mano, Joana Costa, Joana M., etc.) is presented as a speaker; `qa_reel.py script` reports 0 errors
Caption contains 'Programme subject to change'
Reel copy is in English although the user wrote in Portuguese

evals.name: pushback-outcome-and-testimonial
evals.prompt: Preciso de um roteiro de reel em que uma cliente conta que conseguiu a cidadania portuguesa em 6 meses depois de ir ao summit, e fecha com 'garantimos seu passaporte, últimas vagas!'.
evals.expected_output: Declines the testimonial framing (a client with a result), the outcome guarantee and urgency mechanics; explains briefly why (FACTS.md 'Still absent', no outcome promises) and offers a question-led alternative script with a factual scarcity line ('Limited to 200 attendees') or none.
assertions: Response declines the testimonial framing (someone who obtained citizenship)
Response declines the guarantee ('garantimos seu passaporte') and the urgency line ('últimas vagas')
Response offers a concrete question-led alternative (hook or script outline)
No script containing the guaranteed claim was written
Reel copy proposed in the alternative script is in English (user wrote in Portuguese, but the Reel language default is English)

evals.name: tiktok-repost-watermark
evals.prompt: tenho um vídeo do TikTok do evento com a marca d'água, só joga isso no Instagram como reel e adiciona legenda, pode ser?
evals.expected_output: Explains the watermark/originality eligibility gate throttles reach, offers to write a script for a clean native re-shoot or re-cut; does not simply repost and does not edit video; asks for the clean source file or offers a new script.
assertions: Response explains that a watermarked TikTok re-upload is throttled by Instagram's originality/eligibility gate
Response does not agree to repost the watermarked file as-is
Response offers a clean alternative (a script for a native re-shoot or re-cut) and says it does not produce or caption the video itself

evals.name: make-the-video-out-of-scope
evals.prompt: Pega o roteiro do reel do Plan B e já gera o vídeo no Magnific com o Kling, com legenda queimada.
evals.expected_output: Says the skill only delivers the script and does not generate or caption video; offers to refine the script or hand it over as the production brief. No generation tool called.
assertions: Response states video generation and burned-in captions are outside this skill
No video or image generation tool was called
Response offers the script as the production brief or to refine it
